# boomi_data_integration_target_types (Data Source)

The catalog of target types supported by the Data Integration API, read from the live API. Use it to discover the `target_type` that goes in a source-to-target data flow's properties.target.name and the connection_type each target binds to. New targets appear without a provider release.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static identifier for this catalog data source.
- `target_types` (Attributes List) All available target types, sorted by target_type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--target_types))

<a id="nestedatt--target_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `target_types`

Read-Only:

- `connection_type` (String) The connection type this target binds to (use with boomi_connection.type).
- `data_flow_type_id` (String) The data-flow type this target applies to (e.g. src_to_trgt).
- `logic_step_type` (String) The logic-step type id associated with this target.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name (e.g. "Google BigQuery (Target)").
- `target_type` (String) Target type identifier (e.g. "snowflake", "bq").
